title: Rename meeting type terminology from “Weekday” to “Mid-week” across attendance UI

requirements.text: In the Record Attendance modal meeting type dropdown, replace the option label and stored value "Weekday Meeting" with "Mid-week Meeting", while keeping the "Weekend Meeting" option unchanged.

quotes: In the Record Attendance modal, change the dropdown option from "Weekday Meeting" to "Mid-week Meeting".

acceptanceCriteria: When opening the Record Attendance modal, the meeting type dropdown shows "Mid-week Meeting" and "Weekend Meeting" options.
Selecting "Mid-week Meeting" submits/saves the meetingType value as exactly "Mid-week Meeting".
No other labels, validation messages, or behaviors in the modal change.

requirements.text: In the attendance statistics summary UI, change the user-facing label text from "Average weekday attendance" to "Average mid-week attendance".

quotes: In the attendance statistics section, change "Average weekday attendance" to "Average mid-week attendance".

acceptanceCriteria: The attendance statistics section displays "Average mid-week attendance" (and continues to display the weekend label unchanged).
No other statistics wording, calculations, or layout changes occur.

requirements.text: In the meeting attendance record cards list, replace the displayed meeting type text "Weekday Meeting" with "Mid-week Meeting" wherever it appears.

quotes: In the attendance record cards, change "Weekday Meeting" to "Mid-week Meeting".

acceptanceCriteria: Attendance record cards never display the phrase "Weekday Meeting".
Cards display "Mid-week Meeting" in its place, while leaving other card fields (date badge, counts, names, actions) unchanged.

requirements.text: Update any other user-facing UI text across the frontend that contains "Weekday" to use "Mid-week" instead, and ensure attendance statistics calculations continue to correctly classify existing stored records that may still contain "Weekday" as mid-week records.

quotes: Update anywhere else that displays "Weekday" to say "Mid-week" instead.

acceptanceCriteria: A sweep of the frontend UI finds no remaining user-visible occurrences of the word "Weekday".

Mid-week average calculations and any mid-week filtering/aggregation continue to include both legacy "Weekday" records and new "Mid-week" records so historical data remains reflected in the mid-week stats.

constraints: Keep everything else unchanged besides replacing the specified terminology.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not introduce backend state/schema changes unless strictly required for this terminology update.
nonGoals: No redesign or visual restyling beyond the text replacements.
No changes to authentication, permissions, or data model beyond what is necessary to support the terminology update.
No data migration of existing records is required if the app can remain compatible with existing stored "Weekday" values.
